headline: China restricts tungsten exports, impacting AI chip supply chain
summary: China has tightened export controls on tungsten, a critical material used in the manufacturing of artificial intelligence chips. The move is expected to favor Chinese suppliers and increase costs for global tech manufacturers.
why: Tungsten is a strategic metal essential for high-tech industrial applications, and China is the world's dominant producer.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Increased costs for raw materials negatively impact margins for chip manufacturers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Supply constraints on critical raw materials for the semiconductor industry create cost pressures and supply chain uncertainty for global tech firms.
